slides.title: 30 questions to *get to know each other* again
slides.sub: Even after years together. Six courses, no phones.

items.text: What did you want to be *when you were little?*
What smell takes you straight back to childhood?
What’s your comfort food after a bad day?
Which song could you listen to forever?
What’s the best gift you’ve ever received?
What’s your ideal free Sunday?
Which place in the world feels *most like you?*
What movie could you rewatch endlessly?
What’s your favorite memory from this year?
What compliment do you never forget?
What small thing always makes your day?
What’s a fear you’ve *never outgrown?*
What habit are you trying to break?
What was the last thing that made you cry?
What do you pretend to like but secretly don’t?
What’s your favorite thing we do together?
When do you feel *closest to me?*
What do I do that you’d never want me to stop?
What tradition should we start?
Which place do you want us to go back to?
What does a perfect *ordinary* day look like?
What’s a dream you haven’t chased yet?
What are you most proud of?
What do you want to be remembered for?
What’s one thing you want us to learn together?
What made you *fall for me?*
What’s your favorite photo of us?
What’s one word that describes us?
What’s a song that reminds you of us?
What have you *always wanted to tell me?*

slides.title: Save this *for your next dinner date.*
slides.sub: One course per date. You’ll get through the menu in six.
